item.title: [+1] India to Rework US Trade Deal Amid Changing Global Economic Conditions: Piyush Goyal
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 5 reports from India Business Trade, BW Businessworld, boldnewsonline.com and 2 more. Related: “India-US trade deal: Goyal says pact negotiations to be finalised in line with changed circumstances”. Turn: earlier readings (11 Oct) pointed the other way.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Engineering exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
